catalog.applies_to: Liquid AI as the creator of the LFM (Liquid Foundation Models) families it trains and announces.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Liquid AI publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Liquid AI a pilot creator.
huggingface.co is an already-trusted generic host reached at https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI for the LFM2 model cards; it is not re-approved here.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Liquid AI's official blog; authoritative for its model release announcements and the dates they carry. Bounded to /blog, the section checked.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30: the LFM2 announcement at /blog/liquid-foundation-models-v2-our-second-series-of-generative-ai-models returned HTTP 200 with article:published_time content='2025-07-10' and the text 'Today, we release LFM2', on the Liquid-owned www.liquid.ai host. It describes three dense checkpoints at 0.35B, 0.7B and 1.2B parameters.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Reached 2026-08-30 for the LFM2-1.2B model card (HTTP 200). huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved.

ambiguities.topic: LFM2 is a hybrid transformer, not a non-transformer model
ambiguities.note: The LFM2 announcement and the LFM2-1.2B card state it 'consists of 16 blocks: 10 double-gated short-range convolution blocks and 6 blocks of grouped query attention', and the card's config.json lists num_attention_heads 32.
ambiguities.guidance: Record LFM2 as a hybrid architecture that includes grouped-query attention. Do not describe it as non-transformer; the source outranks any earlier framing that did.

ambiguities.topic: LFM Open License v1.0 is not OSI-approved
ambiguities.note: LFM2 weights are published under the LFM Open License v1.0 (slug lfm1.0).
ambiguities.guidance: Record the weights as downloadable and open-weight but osiApproved false, and cite the OSI licence index for the non-approval.
